summary: Iteration 2 testing: 21/21 backend pytest tests passed for invites (link + acceptance + login-after-accept), notifications (task assign + deal stage broadcast + mark single/all read), global search (scoped to workspace, 6-item cap), and Stripe Flow B billing (plans, subscription, checkout, payment status). Frontend: Playwright verified theme toggle (dark<->light with localStorage persistence), Cmd+K command palette, notifications bell, billing page with 3 plans and correct prices ($0/$29/$79), Team invite dialog produces copyable /invite/<token> link, and /invite/:token page renders + accepts + redirects to /app.

minor.issue: Invalid plan_id (e.g. 'starter', 'free') returns 422 (pydantic Literal) rather than the 400 stated in the spec. Semantically equivalent — tests accept both.

Generated invite_link uses APP_URL from env (currently workspace-crm-6.preview...) but running process appears to have resolved a stale hostname (7e73e66e-...preview...). Both hosts route to the same backend so acceptance still works, but the link shown in UI does not match REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Consider restarting backend or deriving from request origin as a fallback.

Existing workspaces created before Iteration 2 have plan='free' (create_workspace sets it), but Billing.jsx compares against PLANS keys {starter,pro,team}. Result: no 'Current' badge on Starter for pre-existing workspaces. Backfill plan='starter' or map 'free'->'starter'.

ui_bugs.issue: Sonner 'Welcome back' toast overlays the top-right area where theme-toggle/bell sit and can intercept clicks during its 3s visibility window. Consider moving toaster to bottom-right, or lowering z-index, or shortening duration.

issues: No 'Current' badge on Starter for legacy workspaces because plan='free' (see backend minor issue). Team plan CTA gradient/color combos read fine in both themes.

action_items: Backfill workspaces with plan='free' to plan='starter' (or normalize in backend) so the 'Current' badge highlights the correct plan card.
Restart backend or read APP_URL/origin at request time so invite links use the current preview hostname.
Optional: move sonner Toaster to bottom-right so it doesn't sit over topbar controls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1094 lines — please split into routers/ (auth, workspaces, invites, notifications, billing, ai, email) for maintainability.
billing_checkout imports emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout inside the handler on every call — acceptable but move to module top for a small perf/readability win.
AI JSON parsing in /api/ai/score-lead still lacks try/except around json.loads (would 500 on malformed model output).
create_workspace defaults plan='free' but Billing UI and PLANS dict use 'starter'. Pick one and be consistent.

Payment webhook (POST /api/webhook/stripe) not tested in this run (skipped per instructions). GET /api/payments/status polls Stripe as fallback and correctly gates promotions to plan via _mark_paid — good.
Invite link is generated from APP_URL only; falling back to request origin (or REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) would be more robust.
test_credentials: Demo owner: demo@nexus.com / demo1234. Dynamic invitees per-run via /invites/{token}/accept with password 'invpass123' or 'invitedpw123'.
seed_data_creation: Backend suite seeds a fresh owner + workspace + invitee per run; frontend flow seeds one Team invite + accepted user against the demo workspace.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (independent of iter-1 suite). Uses Stripe Flow B via emergentintegrations with STRIPE_API_KEY=sk_test_emergent — checkout URL must start with https://checkout.stripe.com. When testing theme toggle via Playwright, dispatch click via JS or wait ~4s for the login toast to auto-dismiss, otherwise the sonner toast intercepts the click even with force=True.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Minor UX regression: legacy workspaces created with plan='free' don't get the Starter 'Current' badge because Billing page checks currentPlan against 'starter'/'pro'/'team'. Fix by backfilling or updating create_workspace default.
